title: Chapter 137
text:
Immediately, Han Xiao's tablet received a warning from Spider No.1. He immediately jumped into the truck's driver's seat and called out to Mad Blade. In the past two days of waiting, Mad Blade had not gone offline even once. Han Xiao remembered that the gaming cabins in this era did not have a complete body detection function and nutrition maintenance.

As expected of a professional player, his kidneys were really good.

"Let's go," Han Xiao said.

"Oh …" Mad Blade was confused. He did not know what to do, but following Han Xiao was definitely the right choice.

The black truck was equipped with a layer of SUI anti-radar coating. This was something that Han Xiao had created using [Basic Wide Area Sensing]. The effect was not bad, and it could reduce the chances of being detected by radar.

Once Stardragon and Germinal's ground forces met, it would be a good opportunity to take advantage of the situation.

First, he had to find a suitable sniping spot, not too close to the battlefield. Han Xiao had already chosen his destination. It was a hill in Cloud Valley, and it was perfect for him to aim at the open ground behind the forest. Once the Germinal troops left the forest, his thirsty big gun would be able to unleash its power.

The only problem was that he had to get to the back of the hill and not be detected by the military radar. The coating was not 100% effective, and there was a chance of being exposed. However, he was not worried. When the Germinal troops got close, the army in the valley would not be able to care about him.

The truck sped into the valley forest.

…

"Commander Huang! The radar shows a suspicious target! "

In Stardragon's command tent, a soldier shouted. Huang Qiuming rushed to the front of the radar screen. At this time, he saw a flashing light entering the range of Cloud Valley. The signal was intermittent. It seemed that the enemy had a certain level of anti-radar ability. However, Stardragon's army was carrying military radar, and its power was very high.

"Only one target?" Huang Qiuming frowned. He felt that it was a scout of the Germinal Organization, but the position shown by the radar was not in the same direction as the Germinal Organization.

"No matter what, let's take care of it first." Huang Qiuming did not want any accidents to affect the plan. Just as he was about to order an assault team to attack, all the radar screens went black!

"What's going on?"

Huang Qiuming shouted.

The soldiers hurriedly calibrated, but to no avail.

"Sir, the radar has been paralyzed by a strong electromagnetic radiation. The direction of the attack is the Germinal Organization's route of advance. Three minutes ago, we observed their tracks and concluded that the enemy has some kind of advanced radar destroying device!"

"They want to turn us blind. Activate the backup radar and implement electronic silence. Turn it on randomly every five to twelve seconds." Huang Qiuming's face was calm as he quickly gave out orders. As for the suspicious target from before, he could only temporarily put it aside. The most important thing was the Germinal Organization's main force.

All of a sudden, a shrill sound rapidly approached them from the sky.

More than a dozen mid-range missiles flew toward Stardragon's base, leaving trails of flame behind them. Suddenly, they split into countless warheads in the air. These were the cluster bombs, and they fell rapidly.

…

At the same time, the ground troops of the Germinal Organization, who had just fired the missiles, finally entered the forest area around the Cloud Valley.

Ugar's expression was solemn. The convoy was carrying an experimental anti-radar device developed by the Germinal Organization. It could detect radar detection and release strong electromagnetic radiation to remotely destroy a working radar, reverse-guiding the location of the enemy radar.

Ugar thought that it was the enemy's base, so he ordered the few honeycomb missile launchers in the convoy to attack and release the cluster bombs. This was a stable weapon that had passed the experimental stage.

He did not know that destroying Stardragon's radar had indirectly helped Han Xiao.

This method would definitely not be able to kill Stardragon's troops. As expected, from afar, Ugar saw a dense array of intercepting machine guns firing at the sky, destroying all the cluster bombs in mid-air.

Both sides were prepared. It was just a matter of which side was more prepared!

"The enemy will reactivate the radar soon. We don't have much time. We must rush over immediately!"

Ugar's expression was serious as he ordered, "Mine detection vehicle, go!"

The vehicle equipped with a mine detection vehicle came to the front of the convoy and quickly detected the range of Stardragon's mines. It used the machine guns to detonate them in advance. Amidst the flames and explosions, the Germinal Organization's convoy moved forward without any danger.

However, the anti-radar device was detected again. This time, Stardragon used electromagnetic silence and quickly turned it off before the Germinal Organization's anti-radar device was activated to prevent it from being destroyed again. That was when Ugar knew that the real battle was about to begin.

The sound of the rotors of the helicopters could be heard from the sky, approaching at a low altitude. The next second, the cannons roared and attacked from above. The Germinal Organization's convoy could only endure the gunfire and charge forward. It was extremely dangerous.

In the sound of gunfire, Ugar roared, "Release the graphite bombs!"

More than a dozen small graphite rockets shot into the sky and exploded in the midst of the helicopters. Many of the helicopters suddenly began to fly in a random direction. The graphite bombs could cause a wide range of electrical short circuits. Stardragon's helicopters were at a disadvantage, and their cannons became sparse.

"Mihawks, when we rush out of the forest, you immediately lead the assault team to attack the enemy's base and execute the decapitation! Your mission is very important. At the very least, you have to divert the enemy's attention! "Ugar said in a deep voice through the walkie-talkie.

In one of the troop carriers, the muscular Mihawks responded with a faint "Hmm". He was the executive officer of the Germinal Organization's ground forces. He had long been famous for his ferocity. He was a strong Pugilist, and his tactical mission was to lead a few teams of elites to attack the enemy's position with individual bombs. The Pugilist's agility and the bulletproof vest on his body allowed him to weave through a hail of bullets.

The role of Supers on the battlefield was usually to attack and decapitate.

On the other side of Stardragon's base, Huang Qiuming looked at the Germinal Organization's troops moving quickly in the forest without any expression. "Prepare the missile cover array. Armored vehicles on standby. Also, prepare the elite teams to deal with the enemy's assault team!"

Stardragon's elite teams were the strongest and most elite soldiers in the army. There were also Supers among them. Supers had the ability to decapitate on the battlefield, so Stardragon was already prepared and ready to go.

The scene of a large-scale battle shocked Sleepy Winter, Twinkle Fried Rice, and Rainy Kim from the logistics team. The tense atmosphere, the smell of smoke, and the roaring of the cannons made it obvious that they did not have the ability to participate in the battle.

"When the missile came, I thought we were going to die." Twinkle Fried Rice patted his chest with a face full of fear.

Sleepy Winter smiled bitterly. "Just focus on transporting the supplies. We can't handle those combat missions."

Rainy Kim's face was cold, but there was a hint of determination in her voice. "I want to try."

"We only have a few small pistols. What can we do?"

"I want to try."

"Forget it. We're just going to die."

"I want to try."

Sleepy Winter and Twinkle Fried Rice looked at each other and said helplessly, "Okay, okay, okay. You're beautiful, and you're the boss. Let's go together."

Rainy Kim was expressionless. After getting the two's agreement, she turned around and left. The two had no choice but to follow behind.

…

While the battle was going on, Han Xiao drove slowly to the destination. The view from the hills was wide, and he could see the intense explosions in the forest in the distance.

Some of the spider detectors hidden in the forest were destroyed by stray bullets, but the rest were still faithfully broadcasting the latest battle situation to Han Xiao. From the location, the Germinal Organization fleet would be out of the forest soon and enter the plains.

Further away, on the Tedramira River, there were also flames rising. Han Xiao took out his binoculars and saw that the Germinal Organization fleet on the river was being attacked. The intensity of the attack was even greater than the one in the Cloud Valley.

Before the Germinal Organization fleet reached the estuary, they were bombarded by a group of fighter jets. The missiles fell like rain, and the fleet's machine guns could not stop for even a second. The scorching orange bullets swept across the night sky, and there were sparks in the sky. If one did not know the details, they would have thought that it was fireworks.

"It's time to prepare."

With that thought in mind, Han Xiao took out a few small Foldable Turrets. After thinking for a while, he came up with a mission with great rewards and threw it to Mad Blade.

Of course, things like setting up traps should be left to the cannon … players.

While Mad Blade was busy setting up the traps, Han Xiao took out a device that looked like a neck cushion and put it on the back of his neck. The cushion was made of an unknown material, and then he turned it on. A numbing electric shock spread from the back of his neck to his brain. Han Xiao shivered and suddenly became excited as if he had taken psychotropic drugs.

You have received [Excitement] status, + 5% to all attributes for 20 minutes!

This device was called [Electromagnetic Pulse Conditioner]. It was a special equipment that used electromagnetic waves to condition living beings. After using it, it would increase the status. Han Xiao had accidentally obtained this blueprint during a knowledge fusion.

He quickly prepared everything and activated all the necessary statuses. Then, he laid prone with the Ghost sniper rifle and the Crimson Falcon sniper rifle beside him. His eyes were as sharp as an eagle's as he observed the changes in the battle.

Boom!

A bunch of trees were blown up, and the Germinal Organization fleet finally rushed out of the forest.

"Come on, baby."
